svg.title: Interactions as a bending sheet
svg.desc: Two surfaces use identical input domains and projection scales. An additive regression produces a plane. Adding the product feature a times b produces a saddle-like bilinear surface, so the effect of one input depends on the other.

g.text: A learned interaction changes the shape of the prediction
The effect of a now depends on b: ∂ŷ/∂a = 0.8 + 1.3b.
